digest: SPEC S3 requires pollMs default 50ms and a 10ms floor; src/workflow-stop.ts uses default 200 and floor 1. No tests exist. Verified mismatch.

evidence.relevance: Spec S3 sets the pollMs default to 50ms
Spec S3 requires the poll interval never fall below 10ms, even when the caller passes a smaller value
Implementation defaults to 200ms and floors at 1ms, contrary to S3

finalClaim: createWorkflowStopSignal sets pollMs to Math.max(1, options.pollMs ?? 200), so the default is 200ms instead of the spec's 50ms and the floor is 1ms instead of 10ms.
recommendedAction: Change line 67 to Math.max(10, options.pollMs ?? 50) and add a unit test covering the default and a small caller value (e.g. pollMs: 1 yields 10ms behavior).
